Generate one photorealistic first-person RGB view of the same static indoor scene.

TARGET CAMERA:
Camera motion from Image 1:
Turn left about 30 degrees.

Keep the camera center, tilt, roll, and field of view fixed; change only the horizontal heading.

INPUT VIEWS:
Image 1 is the anchor and defines the starting camera pose; the other images are supporting views of the same scene.

SCENE CONSISTENCY:
Use the inputs to preserve scene geometry, object identity, appearance, scale, and layout. Render the target perspective, visibility, and occlusion correctly, inferring newly visible content conservatively.

OUTPUT:
Return one square, full-frame RGB image without added captions, annotations, borders, collage, or panorama.
